messages.en:
{07 00 00}So,{01 00 00 05 00} how do you like my
selection of fine wares?

{07 19 00}Some of them may be a
little too refined for your
tastes, though!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii,{01 00 00 05 00} kuidas sulle meeldib mu
peene kauba valik?

{07 19 00}Mõned neist võivad su
maitse jaoks olla pisut
liiga peened!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Whoa! {01 00 00 0f 00}Hey!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}You afraid of
me or somethin'?

{07 14 00}Heh, {01 00 00 05 00}I won't think you're
greedy or anything! C'mon,
just go nuts, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Ohoo! {01 00 00 0f 00}Hei!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 16 00}Kas sa kardad
mind või midagi?

{07 14 00}Heh, {01 00 00 05 00}ma ei arva, et sa oled
ahne! Ole nüüd,
mine hulluks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}I ain't proud to say it, but
all my furniture has a
certain manly aroma!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Pole uhke seda öelda, aga
kogu mu mööblil on kindel
mehelik aroom!
